[SWS_CM_10440] Aborting method calls in case of locally detected platform fail-
ures
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00213, RS_CM_00214, RS_AP_00114, RS_AP_00119, RS_-
AP_00127
⌈
To notify the adaptive application about locally detected platform failures which pre-
vent an issued (remote) service method call from succeeding, the
ara::com
imple-
mentation shall make the
ara::core::Future
returned by
operator()
of the re-
spective
Method
class (see [SWS_CM_00196]) or by the
Get()
or
Set()
method
of the respective
Field
class (see [SWS_CM_00112] and [SWS_CM_00113]) ready
